title: astracantha rousseana
intro: Astracantha rousseana, commonly known as Paterson's curse or rattleweed, is a flowering plant species in the pea family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Astracantha rousseana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, helping to relieve coughs and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
